tools.name: dumb.co
tools.what: A flip phone with custom software that keeps the useful stuff, like calls, texts, maps and rides, and leaves out the web browser and social media.

tools.name: NoPhone
tools.what: Locks your phone for timed sessions and scheduled routines, so a break from your phone is actually a break.

tools.name: BePresent
tools.what: Blocks distracting apps during scheduled "present sessions" and turns time away from your phone into streaks you can share with friends.
